description: Fetches Hong Kong tunnel and bridge toll information from the Transport Department (td.gov.hk), including time-varying tolls for harbour crossings and details for all tunnels and bridges.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_time_varying_tolls: 获取三大过海隧道(红隧、东隧、西隧)的分时段收费信息; 参数: vehicle_type, time_slot; 必填: 无
  - get_tunnels_bridges: 获取香港所有隧道和桥梁的详细信息列表; 参数: name, toll_type; 必填: 无
  - search_tunnels: 按名称搜索隧道或桥梁; 参数: query; 必填: 无

vehicle_type.description:
车辆类型筛选，用于 get_time_varying_tolls。
可选值: "Private Car", "Motorcycle", "Taxi", "Other vehicles" 等

time_slot.description:
时段类型筛选，用于 get_time_varying_tolls。
可选值: "peak", "off-peak", "normal", "transition" 等

name.description:
隧道/桥梁名称筛选，用于 get_tunnels_bridges。
支持部分匹配，如 "Cross Harbour", "Lion Rock", "Tsing Ma" 等

toll_type.description:
收费类型筛选，用于 get_tunnels_bridges。
可选值: "free" (免费), "paid" (收费)

query.description:
搜索关键词，用于 search_tunnels。
在隧道/桥梁名称和描述中搜索匹配项。
